data.name: TougeMaker: Blind Entry
data.detailed_description:
TougeMaker: Blind Entry is a touge racing sandbox built by 2 real life car enthusiasts . It is a game dedicated to the spirit and soul of the mountain pass racing, 3AM late night runs, mastery and rivalry. You build your home mountain pass, master it and let other driver challenge you on the corners you know the best.

FORGE YOUR HOME COURSE

  • Draw Your Line: Click to place nodes, drag to curve the asphalt. Create hairpins, compounds curves, and death-defying drops in seconds. Realistically generated map around your spline with banking and superelevation.

  • Instant Iteration: No loading screens. Switch from building to driving instantly. Tweak a corner, drift it, tweak it again until it feels perfect.

  • Total Mastery: You know exactly where the grip fades because you decided where the asphalt ends.

  • Read the road: No racing lines, decide how fast you approach a corner reading the road signs, tire skid marks and even vegetations 

    MASTER THE BLIND ENTRY

    The physics engine is tuned for "Sim-Cade" precision—accessible enough to pick up, but deep enough to punish mistakes.

    • Unique Handling: Different drivetrain layout,FR,FF,MR,AWD provides different driving dynamics

    • The limit: Grip is not a binary switch. Dance on the edge of traction to find the fastest line through the chaos you created.

    • Tune it to your likings: Change the brake balance, suspension setup ,aeros and more to attack different style of mountain pass

    • Original Vehicles: We designed the vehicles from scratch inspired by real life counterparts and legendary mountain racing monsters.

      CHALLENGE THE WORLD

      Built a track that’s impossible to survive? Prove it.

      • Lightweight Sharing: Tracks are saved as tiny data files. Share your "Home Course" with a simple code or file swap.

      • Multiplayer: Having a head to head better on a course you don’t know or having a friendly cruise with drivers visiting your own turf, your decision.

      • Ghost Battles: Download tracks from other architects and try to beat their ghost times on their own turf.

        Buckled up drivers and go chase the dawn.

        Don’t forget to get some energy drink in that vending machine.

        Build,Share,Race.

data.short_description: TougeMaker: Blind Entry is a sandbox racing game capturing the soul of late night mountain racing. Every legend needs a home course—here, you build yours. Sculpt the mountain, master every corner, and defend your record against the world on your own turf.
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: built in sound card
  • VR Support: No VR support
